RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are women, making it virtually impossible to establish that sex discrimination influenced the choice between you. Pointing out that the panel was entirely female provides no legal basis for a complaint and will likely harm your professional reputation.

The outcome reflects differing institutional priorities. While you offer superior technical qualifications and credentials, the municipality evidently prioritized public consultation and stakeholder relations for this leadership position. 

Rather than raising the panel’s gender composition, send a polite follow-up request for constructive feedback. Frame your inquiry around professional development to understand how the municipality weighed technical planning expertise against community engagement experience.
